summary.text: Joanne Benson is a Democratic member of the Maryland Senate for District 24 in Prince George's County, first elected in 2010 and a senator since 2011 after serving in the House of Delegates from 1991 to 2011. Her official page lists her as Majority Whip and a member of the Budget and Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Benson's official page says she was born in Roanoke, Virginia, in 1941 and describes her as a retired educator and school administrator.
It lists a B.S. in elementary education from Bowie State College in 1962 and an M.A. in curriculum and instruction from the Catholic University of America in 1974.
It says she was a school principal in the Prince George's County Public School System and is a member of First Baptist Church of Glenarden.
The page lists her as Chair of the Procurement Subcommittee of the Budget and Taxation Committee.

It also lists her as a member of the Joint Committee on Pensions and the Joint Audit and Evaluation Committee, and as chair of Select Committee No. 7, the Prince George's County Senate Delegation, in 2019 and 2022.
